notes: Milestone 5 had never been started. Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B-Instruct (Apache-2.0) scored 3,478 GSS respondents from a demographic-only profile, using a KV-cache prefix shared across 12 item questions (checked against unbatched to 1.3e-6). Over 74 cells, 1.5B AUC 0.569 against GBM-demog 0.699 and GBM-full 0.780; zero-shot level miss 32.8 points; variance ratio 0.990 (no calibration saving); predicted between-group gap Spearman 0.345 but slope 0.09; LLM-shift beats the source share by 0.76 points (CI 0.12-1.83) and loses to GBM-full by 4.70. 5 predictions: 3 held, 2 partly. Checks run locally: test_local_llm/test_paper_numbers/test_figures pass (10), paper/check_numbers.py 109/0, research build ok, check_md_links ok, cite_check README ok (Qwen2.5 arXiv:2412.15115 resolves), post front matter ok.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
